the design of a high-frequency AC/AC converter based on 4QSW for welding applications.
the control of the rectifier to provide a bipolar current to a welding arc with a high frequency and high amplitude.
the development of a new control scheme for a 4QSW high frequency AC/DC converter to supply welding current to an arc discharge.

the 4QSw rectifier with FPGA-based digital controller is a suitable alternative to the conventional diode bridge rectifier for high frequency welding applications.
